build_dataset_builder: build an INaturalist2021 dataset builder class that downloads and generates image classification examples from JSON and tar archives
create_dataset_info: create dataset metadata with image, label, supercategory, and id features for the iNaturalist 2021 competition dataset
generate_dataset_splits: generate train, mini, val, and public_test splits by downloading tar.gz archives and parsing JSON annotation files
test_dataset_examples: test the _generate_examples method to yield image data paired with category labels and supercategories from JSON annotations
review_split_generators: review the _split_generators method that downloads and extracts image and JSON archives for each dataset split
